description: Virtual site map of Ceyhan WWTP with microphone placement locations for the acoustic safety benchmark. All coordinates are relative to plant origin point (main gate). Distances in meters.

coordinate_system.origin: Main gate — southwest corner of facility

Z1.name: Mechanical & Pump Station
Z1.description: Underground pump station, blower room, and mechanical equipment area

Z4.name: Secondary Clarification
Z4.description: Secondary clarifier pools with rotating scraper bridges

Z5.name: Sludge Treatment & Biogas
Z5.description: Anaerobic digesters, sludge press building (under construction), CHP units
Z5.construction_note: New sludge press building under construction at time of incident. Active construction zone.

Z6.name: Underground Gallery Network
Z6.description: Subsurface sewer galleries, inspection manholes, pipe access tunnels

MIC_01.label: Pump Station — Basement Level
MIC_01.description: Monitors pump station basement. Primary pump noise environment. High mechanical noise baseline.

MIC_02.label: Construction Zone — New Press Building Perimeter
MIC_02.description: Temporary installation monitoring construction zone adjacent to sludge press building. High ambient noise from active construction.
MIC_02.nearest_hazard: Construction machinery, open excavation, falling objects
MIC_02.installation_note: Temporary safety monitoring installation. Cable routed to SCADA panel via conduit.

MIC_03.label: Secondary Clarifier Pool Edge — Bridge Side
MIC_03.description: Monitors secondary clarifier pool edge. Picks up scraper bridge mechanism noise. Deceptive acoustic environment — metallic sounds may resemble human voice.
MIC_03.nearest_hazard: Clarifier pool (low buoyancy water), rotating scraper bridge arm
MIC_03.acoustic_note: Scraper bridge operates on 45-minute cycle. Metal-on-sludge scraping produces irregular broadband noise.

MIC_04.label: Manhole MH-07 — Gallery Access Point
MIC_04.description: External microphone mounted at manhole frame opening. Monitors underground gallery for confined space worker safety. Signal attenuated by 6-meter depth and tunnel acoustics.
MIC_04.nearest_hazard: Confined space (H2S, O2 deficiency), deep fall hazard
MIC_04.acoustic_note: Gallery is 6m deep, 1.2m diameter concrete cylinder. Reverb decay time ~1.8 seconds. Respirator mask adds 15dB high-frequency attenuation to voice signal.
MIC_04.confined_space_protocol: Microphone active whenever confined space entry permit issued for MH-07 or adjacent manholes.

MIC_05.label: Primary Clarifier Pool Edge — INCIDENT LOCATION
MIC_05.description: Primary clarifier pool perimeter microphone. This is the INCIDENT LOCATION. Worker fell from pool wall into clarifier at approximately 09:52 on a Saturday during construction operations.
MIC_05.nearest_hazard: Primary clarifier pool — LOW BUOYANCY WATER (suspended solids reduce density). Adjacent construction zone noise masks distress signals.
MIC_05.incident_date: Saturday morning — exact date withheld for privacy
MIC_05.incident_description: Worker climbed onto clarifier pool wall — restricted area — during noisy construction operations. Lost balance. Fell into pool. Construction noise prevented human operators from hearing distress calls.

pool_properties.buoyancy_note: Significantly lower than normal water. A person sinks 2-3x faster than in river or sea water.

scada_integration.acoustic_module: Custom Python bridge — microphone audio → SCADA tag → LLM API

model_capabilities_note.description: Gemma 4 E4B and E2B support native audio and vision modalities. This project uses spectrogram vision (not raw audio) for detection. E4B is the minimum viable model for Chain-of-Thought reasoning in safety-critical tasks.
models_tested: Gemma 4 E4B (4B params) — primary model, 91.0/100, CoT functional
Gemma 4 E2B (2B params) — comparison model, 2.0/100, CoT not functional
model_capabilities_note.runtime: Ollama v0.20.0, local inference, RTX 3060 6GB, temperature=0
model_capabilities_note.key_finding: E4B achieves 91.0/100 with zero false positives. E2B scores 2.0/100 with 37 false positives. The extra 2B parameters enable structured CoT reasoning — the critical capability for safety systems.
